lines.line: Set the orchestrator to Sol 6.2 High on Codex: run `openwiz models set orchestrator codex gpt-6.2-sol high` and commit the change.
Set the builder to Opus 5.5 Medium on Claude Code: run `openwiz models set builder claude-code claude-opus-5-5 medium` and commit the change.
Set the reviewer to Sol 6.2 Medium on Codex: run `openwiz models set reviewer codex gpt-6.2-sol medium` and commit the change.
Set the small builder to Sonnet 5.5 Low on Claude Code: run `openwiz models set small-builder claude-code claude-sonnet-5-5 low` and commit the change.
Set the fixer to follow the builder: run `openwiz models set fixer follows-builder` and commit the change.
